items.title: Roger Mitchell Interview, 1972-01-19
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Treasure. Treasure. [INTERVIEWEE] Sure. Sure. Separation for that treasure.

ctx.x: Treasure. Yeah. Sure. Yeah. Sure. Sure.

Sure. Sure. Separation for that treasure. Yeah, you had charming, would take you all that. And they'd give him the money, and he'd go get all the stuff. And he had committers working with him to help him. I'm telling you, them were some wonderful days.
